en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of the small frontier town of Williams, Arizona. In the foreground are multiple railroad tracks running horizontally across the image, with telegraph poles beside them. Behind the tracks stands a row of simple wooden and brick buildings comprising the town, with a few two‑story commercial structures visible. Smoke rises from a building in the mid‑distance. Pine‑covered hills and low mountains form the background under a light sky. The card has printed captions along the borders and at the bottom.
